test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined segment in the following sentence.**

Meera is not qualified much but has __**the art of speaking**.__
solution: The correct answer is **"Gift of the gab."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Gift of the gab"** is an idiom that means the ability to speak easily and confidently. (आसानी से और आत्मविश्वास से बोलने की क्षमता) • **Example**: *My friend had the** gift of the gab**__ and gradually defused the situation.* • The sentence suggests that Meera may not have many qualifications, but she is skilled at speaking. • The use of this idiom emphasizes Meera's speaking abilities as a valuable asset. • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "Hope against hope"**, means to continue hoping for something even when it seems unlikely. (किसी चीज़ की आशा तब भी जारी रखना जब वह असंभावित लगे) • **Option 3, "An acid tongue"**, refers to someone who speaks harshly or critically. (कोई व्यक्ति जो कठोर या आलोचनात्मक ढंग से बोलता हो) • **Option 4, "A lick of paint"**, means a fresh coat of paint on something. (किसी चीज़ पर पेंट का ताज़ा कोट) 3e:T80d, The correct answer is **"in the movie theater was reduced."**
